name: kweli-single-place-agent
description: The single place generator — STUB (creates exactly one named place on request, vs. bulk-place-agent's area-based seeding). Real Overpass/Nominatim resolution + write-records logic is not implemented yet; see agent-do.ts's TODO. Independent of the Kweli MCP: exposes its own public POST /tasks, WorkOS M2M gated (no org restriction), so any Nyuchi/Mukoko app can call it directly.
